heading: side
name: 側欄固定標題組＋橫向卡片直列
desc: 左側約四分之一寬的標題組附直向文字連結，捲動時固定；右側是多張橫向排列的外框卡片，每張由小圖、文字與箭頭圖示組成。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊，捲動時其中一欄固定在畫面上，另一欄正常捲動經過。標題組放在左側一欄，約佔內容寬度的四分之一，靠上對齊；標題組包含大標題，下方可放一組直向排列的小型文字連結（以小圓點標示目前選取的一項），最下方可放帶箭頭圖示的文字連結，沒有時省略。右側約四分之三是多個項目排成的直列，每列一筆，每個項目是一張有外框的卡片，橫跨右欄寬度。卡片內由左到右排列：一張橫式圖片，約佔卡片寬的五分之一，垂直置中；中間是文字區，上方是一行次要文字與小標籤，下方是標題（可多行，過長時以省略號截斷）；最右側是一個圓形箭頭小圖示，垂直置中。大標題明顯大於卡片標題。左右兩欄一樣高，左側標題組在欄內固定，右側卡片列較長、正常捲動，最後一張卡片捲到底時左欄跟著解除固定，隨頁面捲走。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，取消固定：標題組移到上方靠左，卡片列在下方，帶箭頭圖示的文字連結移到區塊最下方。卡片橫跨頁面內容寬度，卡片內仍維持圖片在左、文字區居中、箭頭圖示在右的橫向排列，圖片相對縮小。

en.name: Pinned side heading group + horizontal card rows
en.desc: A heading group about a quarter wide on the left, with a vertical set of text links, stays fixed while scrolling; on the right are multiple bordered cards, each made of a small image, text and an arrow icon in a row.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content, in which one column stays fixed in view while the other scrolls past. Place the heading group in a side column on the left, about a quarter of the page content width, aligned to the top; the heading group contains a headline, optionally with a vertical set of small text links below it (the currently selected one marked with a small dot) and a text link with an arrow icon at the bottom; omit them when there is no content. The right three quarters hold multiple items arranged as a list of rows, one per row; each item is a bordered card spanning the width of the right column. Inside each card, from left to right: a landscape image about one fifth of the card width, vertically centered; a text area in the middle with a line of secondary text and a label on top and a title below (may wrap to multiple lines, truncated with an ellipsis when too long); and a small circular arrow icon at the far right, vertically centered. The headline is noticeably larger than the card titles. Both columns are the same height: the heading group stays fixed within its column while the longer card column scrolls normally, and when the last card has scrolled to the end, the left column unpins and scrolls away with the page.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout changes to a vertical stack and the pinning is removed: the heading group moves to the top, aligned left, the card list sits below it, and the text link with the arrow icon moves to the very bottom of the section. The cards span the page content width and keep their horizontal arrangement inside, with the image on the left, the text area in the middle and the arrow icon on the right; the image becomes relatively smaller.

extras.name: 滑過卡片時外框與箭頭強調
extras.prompt: 滑鼠移到卡片上時，該卡片的外框變得明顯，右側的圓形箭頭圖示由空心變成實心，移開後恢復。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消這個效果，卡片維持一般狀態。

en.name: Card border and arrow emphasis on hover
en.prompt: When the mouse moves over a card, that card's border becomes more pronounced and the circular arrow icon on the right changes from outlined to filled, returning to normal when the mouse leaves.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: On touch devices this effect is removed and the cards stay in their normal state.
